strategy_roster.name: Donchian Channel Width Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20) > sma(donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20),20) + 2 * std(donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented 20-bar Donchian width and compares it with its 20-bar mean plus a 2-standard-deviation band; reversion below the mean exits. The documented 2% stop is retained.

strategy_roster.name: Commodity Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(252) exceeding ROC(21) is equivalent to positive 12-month momentum excluding the latest month. Cross-sectional TopN ranking, monthly scheduling, and commodity breadth are unavailable, so positive qualifying momentum is the per-ticker proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: Directly preserves the documented Bollinger length 20, multiplier 2, lower-band long entry, and upper-band exit. No stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: EPSI Multi SET
strategy_roster.notes: The long rule preserves the documented High-Open >= 20 entry. A bearish close is the closest representable reversal exit; the 20-point take-profit and 200-point stop are absolute price levels, not percentages, and the 02:00-20:00 session filter is unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Auto SL-TP Setter
strategy_roster.notes: This utility generates no entries and only attaches fixed-pip or ATR-based protection to externally opened positions. The false price guard preserves that no-signal behavior; configuration-dependent protection cannot be encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Trendless AG Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: Price distance from SMA(7), smoothed with length 5, proxies the documented custom histogram; an upward turn enters long and a downward turn is the opposite exit. Fixed 1000/2000 price-unit protection is not a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Color Momentum AMA
strategy_roster.notes: With no documented numeric defaults, ROC(10) smoothed by EMA(5) proxies momentum plus Kaufman AMA; positive one- and two-bar changes represent consecutive rises and negative changes represent the opposite exit.

strategy_roster.name: Simple FX
strategy_roster.notes: The documented short-over-long EMA crossover is preserved. Because no period defaults are supplied, 10/25 is an explicit research fallback; point-based stop and target fields remain null.

strategy_roster.name: MartingaleEA-5 Levels Strategy (StockSharp)
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy supervises externally opened positions and has no initial entry signal. The false price guard avoids fabricating exposure; position-dependent five-level averaging, volume multipliers, pip ladders, and currency PnL exits are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Signal Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented MACD 23/40/8 crossovers exactly for the long side, with the opposite crossover as exit. Point-based stop, distant target, and partial profit cannot be represented as percentage exits.
